description: This file defines the SerialNativeInterface class for native serial port access in Java within the jSSC library. It manages library loading, system detection, and declares native methods for serial port operations such as open, set parameters, read/write data, and retrieve port info.

classes.name: SerialNativeInterface
classes.description: Provides native methods to interact with serial ports, handling low-level port operations through JNI, along with library management and OS detection.

methods.name: getNativeLibraryVersion
methods.description: Returns the version string of the native library.

methods.name: openPort
methods.description: Opens a serial port with specified name and options.

methods.name: setParams
methods.description: Sets communication parameters for an open port.

methods.name: purgePort
methods.description: Purges input/output buffers of a port.

methods.name: waitEvents
methods.description: Blocks until events occur and returns event info.

methods.name: getBuffersBytesCount
methods.description: Returns system buffer states for port.

methods.name: getLinesStatus
methods.description: Gets status of serial port lines.
